summary: Most of the app now works, running on one computer with stand-ins for the outside services: sign up, follow and read journeys, start your own, post entries with photos, like, comment, follow people, Activity, search, settings, report and block, completing a journey with its recap, and shared journeys. Ten sample creators make it feel alive while you test alone.
next: Run it on your Mac and open it on your iPhone in Expo Go (the Run it page has the steps). Sign up, follow a few journeys, start one and post an entry with a photo. Tell me what you see and what feels wrong.
I continue with: the map, the weekly digest, share pages, clips and offline drafts.
Review the 66 screens on the Screens page and comment on anything to change.
Confirm the accent colour once the screens are reviewed (Sun for now).

open.a: Sun for now. Iris and Lagoon stay switchable until you have reviewed every screen.
"Journey" is taken in the app stores. Needed before the beta ends.
Emoji for now; custom 3D icons can replace them later.

updates.text: **Shared journeys work.** Invite up to three people who follow you; they join only by accepting, add their own entries, and the journey shows every author. The owner stays in charge; a friend can leave at any time. 46 API tests.

**Search, settings, safety and finishing a journey.** Search for journeys and people; settings with a switch per notification, privacy, appearance and deleting your account; report and block; challenge progress; completing a journey with a closing note and its recap. The API has 44 tests, and the browser walk-through now covers 54 screens and states in light and dark.

**The core loop works end to end.** Sign-up with interests and journeys to follow, Home, the Following feed, Discover, journey pages, the story line, entries, starting a journey, posting with photos, likes, comments, creator profiles, followers and Activity. The Java API has 38 tests; a browser walk-through uses every screen in light and dark. Ten sample creators come with it and react when you post.

**Building has started.** M1, step 1: a Java (Spring Boot) API and the Expo app, sign-in with a test code, creating a profile, the tab bar, and automatic checks. Decided: **local first**, with accounts connected at the end. New page: Run it on your Mac.

**Tech stack final.** The backend is Java (Spring Boot), so you can debug it; Supabase supplies the database and sign-in. Every choice was checked against current versions and prices. New on the Tech page: how we test without the store accounts, and which account is needed when.

**Decided:** shared journeys and a weekly digest join the first version (about 15 to 17 weeks). Search-friendly pages and featured journeys come during the beta; the other ideas wait for its numbers. New screen: the weekly digest.
**Shared journeys** designed as a proposal (6 screens): friends add to one journey, and it shows on each profile. New **Engagement** page: what brings people back, what to add and when.

**59 screens in 12 groups**, from sign-in to deleting an account: login, registration, feed, discover, story line, posts, create, activity, profile, settings, safety and states. **Sun** chosen as the accent.
**The Journey Hub** replaces Figma: screens, design system, cues, inspiration, requirements, roadmap and tech in one page, built from the repo. Comment buttons added.
**Design 2.0**: real photos, bold type, glass controls, light and dark, three accent colours to choose from.
**Requirements finalized** with your eight decisions: both audiences, short video clips, worldwide in English, free with no ads.
First designs (v1) in Figma: a warm paper look. Replaced by Design 2.0 after your review.
Requirements, tech stack, roadmap and design brief written from your earlier AI discussions.
Project started, with its own cloud environment.
